title: Su Tung-p'o: Selections from a Sung Dynasty Poet

publication.edition: trans. Burton T. Watson (partial CUP records cite 1964/1965; Archive.org and multiple citations give 1965)

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed via Archive.org record (Columbia University Press, 1965), Burton Watson biography (CUHK RCT), and independent citations; the Red Cliff rhapsody's composition during the Huangzhou exile (1082) is standard and consistent across records.

limitations: The fu form's rhetorical question-answer architecture, tonal parallelism, and allusive density are only partly recoverable in Watson's English prose versions; the reflective turn arrives simplified.

copyright.notes: Columbia University Press translation copyrighted; Chinese original long in the public domain. Described only; no translated passages reproduced.
